john.avatarAlt: Visual representation of John Styles, Fleek Authority's digital stylist

meta.title: Fleek Authority | Transform your style with John Styles
meta.description: Fleek Authority brings together curation, tools and John Styles, the digital expert who helps you solve what to wear for every occasion.

hero.kicker: Fleek Authority · Style for real life
hero.title: Transform your style for everything life brings
hero.description: At Fleek Authority, you find curation, tools and John Styles, the digital expert who knows your wardrobe and solves what to wear for every occasion.
hero.trustLine: John Styles combines artificial intelligence, context and styling expertise to guide a choice that always remains yours.
hero.pilotNote: Pilot experience. Your choices and data remain private.
hero.imageAlt: Woman and man in monochrome tailoring in a high-contrast urban editorial scene
hero.imageCaption: The digital expert Fleek brings in to solve your style.

principle.label: Experience principle
principle.text: Fleek turns what you already own into new style possibilities.

how.title: A personal solution to the problem of deciding what to wear
how.description: John knows your pieces, understands the context and presents combinations for work, dates, travel, events and everyday life.

wardrobe.title: Your wardrobe becomes a repertoire
wardrobe.description: Every registered piece helps John discover useful combinations without pushing unnecessary purchases.

conversation.title: Context shapes the choice
conversation.description: Occasion, time, weather, comfort and intention make the guidance more precise for real life.

tryOn.title: You receive options that work
tryOn.description: John presents combinations, explains the choices and adjusts the details with you before you go.

occasions.title: The same person can dress for many moments without losing their identity
occasions.description: Fleek expands your repertoire while John adapts every dress code to your style, from work to the weekend.
occasions.imageAlt: Woman in an elegant look and man in casual clothes walking through a cultural district at dusk

solutions.title: When your wardrobe needs to evolve, Fleek connects guidance and curation
solutions.description: Store and subscription are concepts under validation to turn real needs into smarter choices without random purchases.

store.title: Fleek Store
store.description: Explore the available catalogue while we connect each recommendation to what is truly missing from your wardrobe. The offer is still limited by category and audience.

subscription.title: Fleek Subscription
subscription.description: Recurring curation built around the gaps John identifies. Format, availability and service composition remain under validation.

journal.title: A stronger repertoire for better style choices
journal.description: Analysis, references and practical guidance to understand style codes, use your wardrobe better and decide with greater clarity.
journal.empty: Fleek Journal brings together content about style, occasions and wardrobe decisions.

final.kicker: Start with what you already own
final.title: Transforming your style can begin with your next commitment
final.description: Tell John Styles the occasion to receive guidance that considers your context, your intention and the pieces in your wardrobe.

footer.tagline: The place to transform your style.

onboarding.subtitle: Share how you dress, where you live and what you want to communicate to make the Fleek experience truly personal.
onboarding.goalsPlaceholder: E.g. I want presence at work, comfort while travelling and more options for special events.

wardrobe.title: Your wardrobe is the starting point
wardrobe.description: Every piece helps John expand your combinations and guide purchases only when there is a real need.

tryOn.title: See how the look works before you go
tryOn.description: Build, compare and adjust with John Styles while the final decision remains yours.

subscriptionConcept.title: If a piece is missing, let it be the right one.
subscriptionConcept.description: We are creating curation from what John identifies in your wardrobe: real gaps, new combinations and no piece without a purpose. The format is still under validation.
subscriptionConcept.emailSubject: I want to help create Fleek Subscription
subscriptionConcept.hypothesesTitle: Fewer random purchases. More pieces with a purpose.

curation.description: Selections based on style, occasions and real wardrobe gaps.

rhythm.title: Flexible rhythm
rhythm.description: A frequency that follows real needs without encouraging unnecessary consumption.

circulation.title: A wardrobe in motion
circulation.description: Exchange, return or credit possibilities still need operational evaluation.

subscriptionConcept.disclaimer: Format, price, catalogue, frequency, returns and availability have not been defined. This page presents product hypotheses for research, not a commercial offer.

tutorial.title: Teach John about your wardrobe

review.title: Review and save
review.description: Confirm the information before saving. Better records lead to better suggestions from John.
